svg.title: Power Pages ALM, deck 3 of 3: the outer loop
svg.desc: Animated diagram showing the shared outer loop for a Power Pages code site and solution: branching strategy, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and a tagged release promoted through Test and Prod as one immutable artifact.

g.text: Power Pages ALM — the outer loop
After the pull request: branch controls, continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), release, and promotion
Outer loop · 1 — Branch rules keep fixes and releases aligned
Example GitFlow-style model: feature work integrates on develop · releases land on main · main always merges back
→ expedited path · same checks and approvals
Every branch carries both the unpacked solution and the site source, so one commit is one reviewable change.
Outer loop · 2 — GitHub Actions check every change before release
Every branch event triggers the right workflow — validate on PR, build on develop, deploy on tag
Outer loop · 3 — Build once, then promote the same release artifact
Build once on the tag, then promote that same artifact
Definitions travel with the solution; target values
come from the destination or deployment settings.
Protection rules that make this work
Require a pull request, green status checks and linear history.
Require a pull request and passing CI. Squash, then delete the branch.
Repository policy: include the PR validation package
Commit the unpacked source + updated validation package together.
pr-validation.yml rebuilds and compares it; missing or drift fails.
after release or hotfix: merge main → develop
What each GitHub Actions workflow checks
Require the PR validation package + unpacked source; rebuild and compare.
Validate packing · run solution checker · lint · tests · link scan.
Install dependencies · build the code site · pack both solution types.
Publish versioned solution + site artifacts for the release workflow.
Download the exact build · import to Test · run smoke tests.
Require Prod approval · promote unchanged · retain a rollback version.
No direct customisations in Test or Prod — managed solution import only.
A change made directly in Test or Prod exists in no branch, survives no
redeployment and cannot be reviewed. The next import silently erases it.
Fix it in a Dev environment, commit it, and let the pipeline promote it.
the same artifact reaches every environment
Golden rule: build the artifact once on a tag, then promote the identical artifact through every environment.
Developers sync the released baseline into each Dev environment before starting new work.
